module_summary: Destination side of a gray-code CDC FIFO: muxes the async storage array by read index and passes the word through a flushable spill register to the valid/ready output.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: FIFO storage array from source domain, read via dst_ridx_i

anchors.name: dst_ridx_i
anchors.why: Read index selecting the FIFO entry from async_data_i

anchors.name: dst_data
anchors.why: Selected FIFO word fed into spill register data input

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid driven by spill register

anchors.name: dst_ready_o
anchors.why: Spill register ready back to FIFO read logic

groups.name: read_mux
groups.description: Selects FIFO entry from async storage array by read index

groups.name: output_spill
groups.description: Flushable spill register cutting combinational path to output handshake
